assurance.scope: Targeted round-two review of the two policy corrections, inheriting the complete round-one review scope for all 53 reports. This is not a new full literature review, citation audit, experiment audit, or source-freshening pass.

method.correctedFiles: Reconstructed the round-one frozen bytes from baseline commit plus author-policy paragraph replacements, confirmed each correction-ledger before hash, applied replacement text, final hash, and unchanged surrounding file bytes.
method.unchangedFiles: Compared the other 51 current file SHA-256 values directly with their round-one finalFileSHA256 bindings.
method.semanticReview: Re-read only the two corrected sentences in their unchanged local context and confirmed both round-one findings are resolved.
method.inheritedScope: All 234 round-one changed prose/comment blocks and protected-content checks remain inherited through the exact round-one review artifact binding.
method.sourceEscalation: No primary source was reopened; both resolutions are established by the corrected wording and the unchanged local evidence boundaries.
method.productionBoundary: This reviewer made no production edits and performed no email, push, deployment, or other external action.

resolvedFindings.assessment: The corrected comment restores both evidence boundaries: ECO lacks a hard safety guarantee, and an independent safety layer is presented as a conditional deployment need rather than a universal requirement.

The corrected bullet labels improved multi-view understanding as the authors' goal and limits the measured evidence to offline trajectory-generation effects from additional visual and text supervision.
